reason: Two distinct real bugs, not a prompt-wording nit: (1) CRITICAL — logical-key collapse: reference_facts' upsert key (source, source_document_id, convenio_id, topic_id, job_category_id, group_label, validity_start, validity_end) has no per-motivo discriminator; when the model correctly proposed 5 independent facts (matrimonio, fallecimiento, traslado, etc.) for one document, facts 2-5 silently overwrote fact 1 via upsert — convenio 3/10/18's surviving fact is NOT about matrimonio at all, it's whichever motivo the model happened to emit last (union-rep hour credits, formación remission, court-appearance comp respectively) — 4 of 5 real, correctly-extracted facts were destroyed before any human ever saw them, an ADR-0020-adjacent data-loss, not a flag-and-persist outcome. (2) topic-boundary trap confirmed live: convenio 20 and 25's surviving facts are BOTH about cuidado del lactante (wrong topic), and convenio 2's single bundled fact folded a lactancia clause into raw_values.j_lactancia. See review.md for the full analysis and the run2 prompt-only mitigation attempt.
